create_rembert_model: create a RemBERT model using RemBertModel for bidirectional encoder-based language understanding
build_causal_lm_rembert: build a RemBERT causal language model using RemBertForCausalLM for autoregressive text generation
fine_tune_sequence_classifier: fine-tune RemBERT for sequence classification using RemBertForSequenceClassification on GLUE tasks
run_question_answering: run extractive question answering with RemBertForQuestionAnswering to predict start and end token positions
perform_token_classification: perform token classification using RemBertForTokenClassification for NER and sequence labeling tasks
